rendered: Among the ZrO2-coated samples in Table 3[1], the lowest heat generation is at the 1.5 wt.% ZrO2[2] loading, at 446.25[3] J/g. For comparison, the other ZrO2 loadings give 487.31[4] J/g at 1.0 wt.% ZrO2[5] and 688.96[6] J/g at 2.0 wt.% ZrO2[7], while the bare sample gives 666.42[8] J/g. So this loading gives the lowest heat generation of the set.
